title: Career Consultation
tag: Expert Guidance for Your US Journey
full: Tutee Connect provides an invaluable career consultation at free of cost. The results of this consultation will enhance your self-awareness regarding your profile and illuminate potential pathways for career advancement in the United States. Our skilled consultants will accompany you through each phase of the application process, underscoring our vital role in providing tailored assistance.

We take this opportunity to brief you about the USA, including STEM educational benefits, unparalleled employment advantages (CPT/OPT), and the complex scope for eventual transition to H-1B and beyond, all aimed at helping applicants comprehend our exclusive services and developing confidence within their family.

title: Language Test
full: Tutee Connect helps every applicant prepare rigorously for language ability and standardized tests (GRE/GMAT) required by American universities. We offer various training programs conducted by experts and provide free study materials.

To improve language proficiency, students are subjected to several mock tests conducted by the Tutee Connect team before appearing for actual evaluations. Since we have associated with many reputed training institutes for IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, etc., you may be recommended to join there and get trained if needed. Post completion of the training, we will book an official test for you.

title: College Selection
full: We maintain fruitful relationships with institutions in tie-up with us across the United States. Our meaningful approach helps us hold about 95% of college tie-ups in our listed network. Based on the applicant's interest and previous academics, our process experts evaluate and suggest the most appropriate STEM or non-STEM courses and colleges across America.

Course syllabi, credit requirements, future post-graduation scope, and the universities or colleges that offer the perfect program will be clearly explained to students to help them make the definitive right decision for their American academic needs.

title: Documentation
full: Proper documentation will drastically increase your chances to clear all milestones in the US University and Visa application processes. Our process experts will support you by sharing samples, crystal clear requirements, and the strict formatting for every single crucial document (SOP, LOR, Transcripts).

Multiple times we review all the submitted documents at the pre-apply stage itself, thus helping us to avoid any obstacles in the process. In our experience, we have successfully managed many complicated cases, and our strong US admission experts will guide you in preparing flawless documentation for both your college applications and the critical Visa process.

title: F-1 Visa & Interviews
full: Tutee Connect extends exclusive services to provide all essential F-1 Student Visa assistance. Starting from the documentation (I-20 issuance, DS-160 filling, SEVIS fee payments), we take you through every meticulous step of the complex US immigration criteria.

Our strong processing team will help you produce the most compelling financial profiles and sponsor documents. Most importantly, we provide rigorous one-on-one Mock Interview sessions to train you for the F-1 Visa. Thorough interview preparation is the most critical step to avoid unnecessary visa refusals, helping you confidently articulate your goals to US Consular Officers for a hassle-free F-1 Visa clearance.

title: E2E Settlement
full: We specialize in providing End-To-End immigration and settlement services for our applicants far beyond the immediate student visa. Apart from your initial F-1 status, we map out long-term strategic pathways for your American career.

Our US experts analyze your profile and study motives to determine your long-term method of settlement. We provide explicit guidance on successfully transitioning from F-1 to OPT (Optional Practical Training), securing STEM extensions, finding employer sponsorship for H-1B work visas, and understanding the overarching pathways to permanent residency (Green Card) so you can build a beautiful life in the USA.

title: Financial AID
full: Tutee Connect rigorously helps students and parents who are worried about financial support required by US Border Protection for expensive tuition fees and accommodation. We have direct tie-ups with reputed national banks and private finance sectors to aid students financially by offering both collateral and non-collateral education loans.

Besides tuition fees, education loans offered by our partners also finance accommodation during your course time. We will connect you with reputed bank executives for immediate loan sanctions. Also, students demonstrating excellence in academics are actively guided on how to secure lucrative merit-based scholarships and bursaries directly from their chosen American institutions.

title: Post-Landing
full: Tutee Connect has introduced exclusive and essential post-landing services critical for students newly arrived in America. This service includes all the necessary guidance for survival in a complex foreign country.

Once you have landed in the United States, your dedicated consultant from Tutee Connect will arrange or assist you with secure off-campus accommodation, acquiring your Social Security Number (SSN), finding authorized on-campus part-time jobs, setting up US bank accounts, understanding local medical insurance policies, and navigating all other immediate habitat needs.

title: Family Migration
full: We have not just limited our services up to the individual applicant's level; rather, our team works incredibly hard to establish a complete community for you in the United States by helping your family migrate legally and safely alongside you.

We provide expert assistance in navigating complex dependent visa applications. Whether you need an F-2 visa for a spouse and children while you study, or an H-4 visa once you transition to the workforce, we support you completely. "We as a sailor of the ship have been motivated to ensure your safe and smooth landing in some of the world's best lands". Join Tutee Connect to establish your family securely.
